summary.text: Kevin Norwood is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 74 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Norwood earned a bachelor's degree from Southwestern Christian University and graduate degrees from Oral Roberts University and George Fox University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as youth minister and says he has been affiliated with Keep Owasso Beautiful.
He defeated Amy Hossain in the June 10, 2025 special general election for the seat previously held by Mark Vancuren and took office on June 18, 2025.
He advanced from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Aaron Brent, an independent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
